title: clompanus tubulata
intro: Clompanus tubulata, commonly known as the "Mountain Tansy", is a flowering plant species in the genus Clompanus. It is known for its potential health benefits, including being used as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent. Clompanus tubulata contains various bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions.
